parsed_content.name: IDFC FIRST WOW! Black Credit Card

fees.annual_fee_waiver: The annual fee is waived if you spend ₹1.5 lakh or more in a year on your card, as per bank policy

fee_schedule.forex_markup_note: 0% forex markup is charged on transactions made in currencies other than INR. Applies to international POS payments and online purchases charged in foreign currency
fee_schedule.atm_withdrawal_note: ₹199 per transaction is charged on cash advances cash withdrawal using the credit card
fee_schedule.railway_surcharge_note: A surcharge of 1% is applied to transactions made for booking railway tickets
fee_schedule.late_payment_note: Late payment charges are 15% of the Total Amount Due from the previous statement, minus any payments received before the due date (minimum ₹100, maximum ₹1,300).

rewards.exclusions: Fuel, EMIs, Loan, Balance Transfer, Cash withdrawal transactions, Corresponding GST
rewards.exclusion_spends: Fuel, EMIs, Loan, Balance Transfer, Cash withdrawal transactions, Corresponding GST
